description: Calculate single-exposure standardised risk weight, CCF, RWA and 8% capital under EU CRR/CRR3 or BDDK current/draft. Explicit class-specific facts required; do not infer eligibility. Output floor rate is informational, never applied to a single exposure.

amount.description: Amount after provisions and before credit conversion, in currency units; maximum 1e15.

annualSales.description: Consolidated turnover in EUR millions for EU supporting factor, TRY millions for BDDK SME assessment.

counterpartyRw.description: Unsecured counterparty risk weight in percentage points.

currencyMismatch.description: Explicit confirmation of the regulatory currency mismatch conditions for retail/residential.

domestic.description: Explicit confirmation that domestic-currency sovereign preferential conditions are met.

ipre.description: Whether repayment materially depends on property cash flows.

longTerm.description: Required for legacy commitments: whether original maturity exceeds one year.

mdbListed.description: Explicit confirmation that the MDB meets the listed zero-weight conditions.

qualifying.description: Explicit confirmation of all preferential property conditions, including first lien where required.

rating.description: Credit quality step as a string, or unrated; not a rating agency label.

regime.description: Required rule book. bddk is current Turkish rules; bddkDraft is a draft, not current law. Never infer jurisdiction from the conversation language.

sme.description: Request BDDK draft corporate SME assessment using annualSales and smeLimit; never infer eligibility.

smeFactor.description: Explicit confirmation of Article 501 eligibility; EU only, supported classes only.

smeLimit.description: Applicable BDDK Board limit in TRY millions. Turnover must be strictly below it.

smeTotal.description: Article 501 total amount owed E* in EUR, separate from amount and its currency.

year.description: Calculation year for CRR3 phase-ins; does not make draft BDDK rules current law.

name: calculate_standardised
title: Standardised credit risk weight and capital
